goal: Bind native processes to canonical execution custody and fence late state updates
invariants: Execution prompt, workspace and session come from the current canonical run
Inherited run and Manager environment cannot replace immutable custody
A late old process cannot write the replacement run's state
Restart adoption retains the same stamped run and process
Different execution sessions do not reuse Codex threads or old role handoffs
A held execution may be adopted but cannot start a fresh process
Retired planning registrations cannot restart as permanent Managers
Unproven or differently bound hosts remain alive when execution adoption is refused
